info.title: Gridex Website Integration API
info.description: Production API for electricity retail websites and backend integrations. Gridex owns published offers, authoritative pricing and quotes, legal document versions, customer and contract lifecycle state, and downstream processing. Integrations provide verified customer input and use public references only.

post.summary: Submit a customer application with the exact accepted offer, quote, legal evidence and...
post.description: Scope: website_applications.write. Idempotency-Key krävs. Tenant härleds enbart från API-nyckeln. auth_user_id och customer_portal_user_id krävs som samma verifierade UUID. OPS committar canonical kund, kundnummer, site/mätpunkt, avtal, juridik, portalidentitet, workflow och ett beständigt customer_application_continuation-jobb. data.checkout är tenantens enda maskinläsbara sanning för tack-sidan: thank_you_ready=true betyder att avtalet faktiskt är signerat och kan visas som tecknat. confirmation_email.status visar separat om avtalsbekräftelsen är pending, queued, sent, delivered eller failed. E-post, anläggningsuppslag, leverantörsbyte och webhooks fortsätter asynkront och följs via statusendpointen.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

complete_integration_ready.description: True when the configured website checkout and customer portal capabilities are ready for production use.

CustomerType.description: Canonical values. company is temporarily accepted as a deprecated alias for business until 2026-10-31.

id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Contains the same stable external value as offer_reference and never a database UUID.

contract_offer_id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Contains the same stable external value as offer_reference and never a database UUID.

publication_reference.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Contains the same stable external value as offer_reference and never a database UUID.

area_pricing.description: Deprecated presentation-only area pricing. Use top-level price_options[].area_prices for canonical commercial selection.

legal_versions.description: Deprecated compatibility view of legal.module_versions. New clients must use legal.module_versions.

customer_type.description: company is a deprecated alias for business.

offer_reference.description: Canonical opak offer_reference. Måste skickas på top-level.

quote_reference.description: Obligatorisk canonical Gridex-quote. Fältet ligger alltid på top-level; inget konfigurerbart referensplaceringsläge finns eller behövs.

price_area.description: Deprecated klientpåstående. Gridex använder price_area från resolution_id och returnerar konflikt vid mismatch.

external_customer_reference.description: Alias for external_customer_id. Preserved while Gridex assigns or reuses the canonical customer_number.

resolution_id.description: Samma organization-scoped Gridex-resolution som användes när quote skapades. Fältet ligger alltid på top-level.

contract.description: Kompletterande start- och avtalsuppgifter. Lägg inte offer_reference, quote_reference eller resolution_id här.

CustomerApplicationRequest.description: Canonical kundansökan. offer_reference, quote_reference och resolution_id skickas exakt en gång på top-level. Ingen tenantkonfiguration eller quote-reference-mode används. När avtalet kräver fullmakt ska powerOfAttorney vara komplett och externally sendable.

PublicResourceId.description: Opaque, organization-bound public resource identifier. It has no business meaning and must not be used outside the authenticated organization context.

can_dispatch.description: Dispatch readiness is customer-specific and is never inferred from area resolution alone.

WebsiteCustomerApplicationData.description: Explicit public DTO. Internal price-plan, publication, portal-identity, provider-connection and contract-price-snapshot identifiers are never exposed.

WebsiteVisibilityMode.description: Presentation only. Hidden components remain available to the organization calculation engine.

CalculationInclusion.description: Whether the component participates in the calculation. Independent of website visibility.

is_default.description: Canonical source of truth for whether this price option is the default.

default.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for is_default. Always identical to is_default.

customer_type.description: company is a deprecated alias for business.

resolution_id.description: organization-scoped Gridex-resolution. Dess price_area och grid_area_code är canonical.

WebsiteEnergyAreaResolution.description: organization-bound Gridex resolution with independent price-area assurance and readiness for pricing, quote, facility lookup, switch creation and switch dispatch. A single-area postal consensus may allow pricing/quote while facility and EDIFACT actions remain blocked.

price_sek_per_kwh.description: Canonical market reference in SEK/kWh. May be negative.

price_ore_per_kwh.description: Canonical market reference in öre/kWh. Equals price_sek_per_kwh × 100 and may be negative.

source_as_of.description: Timestamp derived from the newest underlying provider evidence.

generated_at.description: Timestamp when the preview calculation was generated.

effective_stale_at.description: Minimum of the global preview limit and organization max_age_minutes applied to source_as_of.

MarketReference.description: Self-contained market reference used by the Gridex quote. preview is indicative and never final settlement evidence. requested_days and included_days expose window completeness. A partial fallback is returned only when organization policy allows it.

scope.description: Exact customer-signed scopes. supplier_switch is mandatory; facility_information_lookup may be added. OPS never widens the scope after acceptance.

signerIdentityNumber.description: Signerande persons identitet. Hanteras som skyddsvärd personuppgift.

textVersionId.description: Use primary_document_id from the power_of_attorney requirement in the exact accepted legal bundle.

PowerOfAttorneyInput.description: Strukturerad fullmakt som krävs för externally_sendable nätägarkommunikation. Bare consents.power_of_attorney=true är endast juridisk acceptans och kan inte skickas externt.

price_area.description: Optional assertion only. It cannot override the canonical area stored on resolution_id.

price_sek_per_kwh.description: Current spot price in SEK/kWh, excluding VAT and all supplier/grid fees.

price_ore_per_kwh.description: Current spot price in öre/kWh. Equals price_sek_per_kwh × 100.

price_ex_vat_sek_per_kwh.description: May be negative. Decimal value is returned without local organization rounding.

price_ex_vat_ore_per_kwh.description: May be negative. Decimal value is returned without local organization rounding.

fallback_used.description: The current interval endpoint never substitutes a historical or cross-area fallback.

MarketPriceErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

EnergyDirection.description: Canonical economic direction. Consumption creates ordinary supply/invoice flows; production creates compensation settlement flows.

ProductionPricing.description: Explicit production compensation contract. Runtime currently supports fixed compensation; additional compensation models require a future contract-version bump.

ApiError.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

legal_bundle_version_id.description: Immutable legal bundle version locked into the publication snapshot. The property is always present; historical explicitly approved exceptions may be null.

customer_documents.description: Customer-facing grouped documents. Render these instead of one checkbox per module_version. module_versions remains the immutable evidence manifest.

requirements.description: Customer-facing acceptance surface. Private consumer offers normally contain agreement, power_of_attorney and withdrawal. Business offers omit withdrawal when no withdrawal modules are published.

requirement_code.description: Use agreement, power_of_attorney or withdrawal from legal-bundle requirements. Exact module keys remain accepted only for backward compatibility.

WebsiteLegalRequirement.description: One of the three customer-facing documents. module_keys and source_document_ids bind the presentation document to every immutable canonical legal module it contains.

ErrorResponse.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

organization_reference.description: Stable opaque public reference for the organization associated with the authenticated API credential.
Stable opaque public reference for the organization associated with the authenticated API credential.

PriceAreaAssurance.description: Canonical evidence used only to decide whether SE1-SE4 is safe for pricing and quote. This object never proves facility, grid-owner, PRODAT or EDIFACT readiness.

CustomerLegalDocument.description: One of the three customer-facing documents. module_keys and source_document_ids bind the presentation document to every immutable canonical legal module it contains.

Forbidden.description: Scope missing or organization access denied

TenantGone.description: organization is terminated and no longer serves external API traffic

TenantPaused.description: organization is paused and external API traffic is temporarily locked

InternalError.description: The canonical API contract feed could not be built

Conflict.description: Expired, consumed or mismatched quote/idempotency state

GridexContractVersion.description: Canonical contract version used for this response.

RequestId.description: Stable request identifier for support and audit.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for conditional retrieval.

Vary.description: Request headers that affect cache validation.

customer_portal.read.replacement: Grant the granular read scopes required by the routes used.

post.description: This callback URL is hosted by the organization, not by app.gridex.se. Gridex signs the exact raw request body with HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`. Verify timestamp freshness and X-Gridex-Signature, then deduplicate X-Gridex-Event-Id and X-Gridex-Delivery-Id before returning any 2xx response. Non-2xx responses enter the documented retry and dead-letter pipeline.

2XX.description: Event accepted and durably deduplicated by the organization receiver.

post.description: Sent after every durable customer-application workflow transition. The organization must verify the HMAC signature, deduplicate event and delivery headers, persist the event, and return 2xx. Non-2xx responses enter the retry and dead-letter pipeline.

2XX.description: Event accepted and durably deduplicated by the organization receiver.

post.description: Sent for every switch- or supply-related customer-application workflow transition. The event is organization-scoped, durably queued, idempotent, signed, retried, and dead-lettered on terminal delivery failure.

2XX.description: Event accepted and durably deduplicated by the organization receiver.
